detail.longDescription: Since Robb Knight's Echofeed is shutting down soon, as you may have seen I built a similar open source RSS feed forwarder inspired by it. It's called Feedecho, as an homage to the original. https:// github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho I am also going to pick up where Robb left off, and offer a paid hosted service. Pricing still to come, but if you would like a 14-day trial code for the private beta, PM me on here and I'll hook you up. 📡🗞️ # opensource # selfhosted # RSS
